original: So you are saying that someone may have been left behind。
contexto:
Dialogue. Adjacent lines in the same event:
Most of the villagers have finished evacuating、 but we have received information that someone heard the voice of a child deep within the forest。
We were planning on confirming the report、 but we had our hands full with these strong demons and were not able to advance at all。。。
Yes。 I am so terribly sorry。。。
It is no big deal。 Our job is to defeat the demons here、 after all。 Might as well take this opportunity to find the kid、 too。
